day_shape: White House renews Iran national emergency; Iran sends nuclear proposal to US via Qatar tied to seven demands; BMTO reports tanker explosion near Khasab in Strait of Hormuz; IRGC claims two smuggler tankers struck mines; US sanctions three over MANPADS procurement; IDF reports 340+ Hezbollah weapons found in south Lebanon.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz tanker incident
threads.summary: The UK's Maritime Trade Operations reported an explosion on a tanker near Khasab, Oman, in the Strait of Hormuz. IRGC-affiliated Defa Press claimed two 'smuggling tankers' with navigation systems switched off struck mines, while an army spokesman said opening the strait requires US acceptance of Iran's seven conditions.

threads.label: Iran nuclear proposal via Qatar
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Iran sent the US a nuclear proposal through Qatar, to be discussed only after Washington meets Tehran's seven demands, with the NYT citing 'concrete proposals' under review in Doha. Iran International reported Tehran stepped up diplomacy after Trump's midterm defeat, with hardliners urging continued pressure.

threads.label: US Iran emergency renewal and sanctions
threads.summary: The White House published a continuation of the national emergency with respect to Iran in the Federal Register. The US sanctioned three individuals linked to Iran's procurement of man-portable air-defense systems, as Jerusalem Post reported on a Moscow-Tehran weapons deal.

threads.label: Iran-Russia leader-level message
threads.summary: Khamenei's office said General Mohsen Reza'i conveyed the Supreme Leader's message to President Putin in a roughly three-hour meeting. Deputy SNSC Secretary Ali Bagheri said the message set out elements for bilateral relations and cited Russian gas transfers and the North-South corridor as strategic plans.

threads.label: Khamenei messaging on US decline
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted a 'Irreversible collapse' message asserting America's hard and soft power have suffered irreversible decline, alongside a strategic orders chart from his meeting with armed forces commanders. Tehran Friday prayer leader Khatami said Iran's armed forces are ready to respond to any threat.

threads.label: IDF Lebanon operations and Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF said troops operating in the Beaufort Ridge and Litani River areas located over 340 Hezbollah weapons and a 7m underground shaft inside a civilian home. Defa Press claimed Israeli shelling continued in east Gaza, Deir al-Balah and Khan Yunis, while the IDF posted on Gaza winter preparations.

threads.label: Iran executions and exile diplomacy
threads.summary: Iran International reported an Iranian court sentenced two more January protesters to death in Mashhad; the US State Department condemned the execution of three young men from the same protests. Belgium's defense minister said Iran threatened Brussels over Reza Pahlavi's speech, which went ahead, and Pahlavi told the Jerusalem Post of a shift in Europe's approach.

events.title_en: Mansour Anwari, author of the longest novel of sacred defence, has passed away
events.summary_en: Mansour Anwari, author of the 12-volume series 'War Road', one of the longest novels of war and revolution, who spent more than 30 years of his life writing the history of the revolution and sacred defence, has passed away. The novel 'War Road' by Mansour Anwari is among the major works of Iranian fictional literature that, with a historical perspective, narrates the fate of people and political and social developments of the country in the context of war and historical crises. This series, passing through several important periods of contemporary history, attempts to depict the impact of war on people's lives, the fate of the land, and social developments in Iran in narrative form.

The Nujaba Movement's statement stressed that the Popular Mobilisation is the beating heart of Iraq and the true manifestation of belief in resistance.
